# TamaWhere — Universal Virtual Pet Engine for Wear OS, Android, Windows & Meta Quest

> TamaWhere is a living virtual pet game and cross-platform engine built for Wear OS smartwatches, Android smartphones, Windows PC, and Meta Quest VR headsets. Featuring 90s-inspired nostalgic pixel art, real-time care mechanics, interactive minigames, deep evolutionary paths, and community modding support.

## Overview
- **Name**: TamaWhere
- **Category**: Virtual Pet / Tamagotchi / Simulation Game
- **Platforms**:
  - Windows PC (Steam & Microsoft Store)
  - Meta Quest (Quest 2, 3, 3S, Pro — Horizon OS spatial floating 2D panel)
  - Wear OS (Smartwatches)
  - Android (Smartphones & Tablets)
- **Developer**: David Kalil Braga
- **Official Website**: https://tamawhere.netlify.app/
- **Official Stores**:
  - Microsoft Store (Windows): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9mxcjn23mzp7?hl=pt-BR&gl=BR (Live)
  - Meta Horizon Store (Quest): https://www.meta.com/pt-br/experiences/tamawhere/1620772423042196/ (Live)
  - Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.xxfalcoonx.tamawhere (In publication process)
- **Business Model**: Free to play, Zero Pay-to-Win, 100% Moddable

## Key Features
1. **Wear OS & Mobile Synchronization**: Play directly on the round watch face with tiles, complications, and quick swipe controls, or continue on your phone for full stats and complete TamaDex management.
2. **Real-Time Care Mechanics**: Feed delicious treats, bathe, clean messes, heal illnesses, and monitor hunger, mood, energy, and weight in real time.
3. **Interactive Minigames**: Play Rock-Paper-Scissors, train strength, or chase the fleeing ball to earn XP and level up.
4. **Deep Evolution System**: 151+ creatures in the base community pack with branching growth stages from cute babies to powerful and legendary forms (e.g., Kitsune, Pegasus, Phoenixa).
5. **Open Engine & Modding (TamaPacks)**: TamaWhere is an open platform. The community can build entire universes using custom pixel art sprites (64x64, 80x80, 96x96), custom sound effects, and JSON rules.
6. **Custom Pet Commission Service**: Players can turn their real-life pets (such as cats and dogs) into playable companions with hand-drawn 3-stage pixel art evolutions.

## Official Downloads
- **Generation 1 Community Pack**: https://tamawhere.netlify.app/downloads/gen1.tamapack (151 creatures, ~12.8 MB, full audio & animations).
